overall: Major: a demonstrated invalid derivation on the core proof path, without a counterexample to the main conclusion.

findings.title: The formal period coordinates use T instead of its inverse
findings.claim: The scheme-theoretic image defined by the columns of the horizontal transport T equals the Zariski closure of the period map defined by pullback along T.
findings.verification: On A1_Q3 take F1=<e1>, T=[[1,0,0],[t,1,0],[t^2,t,1]], Tinv=[[1,0,0],[-t,1,0],[0,-t,1]], omega=-T'Tinv dt. All setup hypotheses hold, including flatness, locally free graded pieces, T(0)=I and a horizontal frame on the closed unit disc. Actual period [1:-t:0] has line closure X2=0; printed formal period [1:t:t^2] has conic image X0X2-X1^2=0. Exact polynomial matrix checks executed; ideal computations proved in report Section 2.
findings.counterevidence: Remark 5.7 gives the correct intrinsic pullback. Uniform inversion of columns repairs the algebraic identification. The example need not arise from an abelian family and does not refute Theorem A.
findings.severity_reason: A proved invalid derivation is directly used in the core finiteness proof. Availability of a simple repair does not make that derivation peripheral.
findings.remedy: Use columns of T^{-1} throughout both formal and analytic comparisons; retain transport direction and ODE.

independent_acceptance.decision: retain Major; demonstrated false intermediate identification on the core proof path
independent_acceptance.independent_reason: Definition 3.1 transports from the base fibre to the variable fibre, so pulling the variable filtration back requires T^{-1}F. The active source big_monodromy.tex instead takes the initial columns of T solving dT=-omega T and T(0)=I. For the stated polynomial triangular matrix, T^{-1}=[[1,0,0],[-t,1,0],[0,-t,1]]; direct row multiplication gives both inverse identities, and T'+omega T=0, with omega/dt rows (0,0,0),(-1,0,0),(-t,-1,0). On A1 over Q3 the bundle and graded pieces are free, the connection is flat in dimension one, and the polynomial horizontal frame is defined on the closed unit disc, whose horizontal scalar functions are Q3. Even Griffiths transversality holds for this two-step filtration. Thus the example meets the general filtered-flat-bundle comparison setup, which is not restricted to abelian families. The actual column (1,-t,0) has affine ideal (v), whereas the printed column (1,t,t^2) has ideal (v-u^2); substitution proves both kernels, and shrinking the disc does not equate the line and conic.
independent_acceptance.counterevidence_and_repair: Remark 5.7 states the correct intrinsic pullback and is genuine evidence of the intended construction, but it does not change the printed coordinate definitions or identify the unequal images. Replacing all relevant formal and analytic columns by those of T^{-1} repairs this specific mismatch: T(0)=I ensures formal inversion, and inversion commutes with field embeddings. This check neither refutes the corrected comparison theorem nor claims that the example is a geometric abelian family.
independent_acceptance.dependency_and_severity: Read the active Lemmas 5.5/5.6, their use in Proposition 5.3, Lemma 5.9 and Corollary 5.10, then the type-(a)/(b) finiteness statements and proof of Theorem 6.5. Section 7.1 and intro.tex lines 85-90 supply the containment-plus-finiteness route to Theorem A. A false identification is on that core derivation, so Major is retained despite the local inverse correction. No counterexample to Theorem A is established.

findings.title: The principal trichotomy is false for permitted nonreduced algebras
findings.claim: The trichotomy applies to finite-dimensional Qp-algebras without a split reduced hypothesis.
findings.verification: K=Q,p=v=3,A=Q3[epsilon]/epsilon^3 with trivial action,E:y^2=x^3-x,B=H1_et(E,Q3),V=A tensor B,L=A tensor Q3(-1). The standard elliptic pairing is perfect and all de Rham, weight, good-reduction and rank hypotheses hold. Unique Q3-algebra map A->Q3 has local orbit 1, so (a) and (b) fail and (c) is the false inequality 1>=3/2. The preliminary proof uses #Sigma<=dim A in the wrong direction.
findings.counterevidence: Actual interpolating algebras are Qp^delta by Remarks 6.3 and 6.6. The averaging argument is valid for these split reduced algebras; the core application does not need the extra generality.
findings.core_dependency_assessment: No failure of the main finiteness argument caused by this defect is established.
findings.severity_reason: False abstract generality is excluded by the actual geometric application; no core failure shown.
findings.remedy: State and apply the proposition for split reduced A=Qp^delta, or formulate a genuinely different general-algebra conclusion.

independent_acceptance.decision: retain Minor; false excess generality excluded in the geometric use
independent_acceptance.independent_reason: Definitions 4.3/4.4 permit a finite-dimensional Qp-algebra with an equivariant perfect alternating pairing, without a reduced or split condition. Proposition 6.7 retains that generality, and its Sigma is Hom_Qp-alg(A,Qp), not geometric points over an algebraic closure. With K=Q, p=v=3 and trivial-action A=Q3[epsilon]/(epsilon^3), there is exactly one such map because nilpotents map to zero in a field. It is fixed by G_Q, so its local orbit size is one. Let B=H1_et(E,Q3), E:y^2=x^3-x. Then V=A tensor B is A-free of rank two (d=1), L=A tensor Q3(-1) is free of rank one, and extension of the usual perfect elliptic pairing gives the required pairing. As a Q3 representation V is three copies of B. Standard smooth-proper elliptic cohomology gives de Rhamness, Hodge--Tate weights {0,1}, and pure integral weight one outside bad reduction; the discriminant 64 gives S={2,3,infinity}. These standard cohomological facts are used, not claimed as numerical computations. Q has no CM subfield, so the source definition makes v self-conjugate. Alternatives (a) and (b) need an orbit of size at least four and fail; (c) reads 1>=3/2 and fails.
independent_acceptance.counterevidence_and_repair: Remarks 6.3 and 6.6 identify the actual interpolating algebra with Qp^delta, hence #Sigma=dim A in the application. Finite etaleness alone would not suffice when maps target Qp; the split reduced restriction is the verified repair. For the split case, summing the source local Hodge--Tate inequalities over delta factors, with s short-orbit factors and isotropic rank m<=d, gives m*delta/2 <= (m-1)*(delta-s)/2 + m*s, hence delta <= (m+1)*s <= (d+1)*s. This validates the required averaging conclusion in the intended application.
independent_acceptance.dependency_and_severity: The unrestricted preliminary inference from #Sigma<=dim A runs in the wrong direction. The displayed counterexample is permitted by the abstract proposition but cannot be the H0 algebra of the geometric fibre used in the main proof. No failure of the core finiteness result follows from this extra generality; retain Minor and do not combine it with F01 to inflate severity.

version_attribution: Findings apply only to the acquired v1; 2024 journal revision and 2025 VoR not compared.
combined_assessment: F02 is not used to inflate the impact of F01; no assertion that Theorem A is false.
